pad_quotes: Annex 8: Implementation Support Team: "This team will receive support from an institutional specialist in the electricity sector, an electromechanical engineer, a civil engineer, a resettlement specialist, a hydropower specialist, a legal advisor, a water resources specialist, a communications specialist, and a monitoring and evaluation (M&E) specialist.", IV. IMPLEMENTATION: "To ensure coordinated management of the water use during the post-construction a d operation of the Power Plant Complex, a Water Resources Technical Sub-committee will be established to ensure adequate water resources management of the Kagera River Basin. The Water Resources Technical Sub-committee shall be responsible for: (i) ensuring compliance with the water use rights and related aspects; (ii) providing oversight in maintaining water levels to ensure that the natural life, water quality and quantity and the Kagera River Basin-wide surroundings, are not adversely affected by the Project; and (iii) facilitating governmental and inter-governmental actions that may be required, including consistent periodic and accurate reporting to the Kagera River Basin Management Team of the water use, including the water quality and quantity.", Annex 3: Implementation Arrangements: "During operations, a competent private entity, which RPCL will select through a competitive and transparent procedure, will be responsible for proper operation and maintenance works, including regular dam-safety inspection and monitoring, and any relevant technical analyses to ensure effective management of the water resources used by the Project, in the context of the RWRMP.", Annex 4: Operational Risk Assessment Framework (ORAF): "A water resources technical committee will  be established  by  three  countries  to  ensure compliance with agreed operating  regimes."
